scope: Secondary diagnostic on the existing complete three-radius RP80 job; keep primary peaks unchanged.
feature: First continuous positive gauge-pressure lobe that reaches the seed; integrate from its preceding zero crossing to its subsequent zero crossing using piecewise linear pressure.
closed_lobe_and_peak_gate: Require both zero crossings inside the fixed window and require the pre-existing scored peak in this first lobe.

qualification: Conditional diagnostic; exact aggregation and experimental zero-crossing extraction unavailable.
